outbreak.mechanics.needs_glass: Fixing the windows takes 2 glass panes and a screwdriver.

outbreak.title: Outbreak
outbreak.new_survivor.title: A new survivor
outbreak.new_survivor.intro: When it starts, how hard it is, and where. Then pick the world.
outbreak.new_survivor.map_groningen: Start points are real places on the Arnis map of Groningen.
outbreak.new_survivor.map_any: Any world: everyone starts at the world spawn.
outbreak.scenario.first_day.desc: It's just started. The shops are still full, the cars still have keys in them, and the dead are only beginning to walk.
outbreak.scenario.week_later.desc: The radio has gone quiet. Others have been through the houses before you, and there are more of them out there.
outbreak.scenario.six_months.desc: Most of the city is picked clean, the cars are burnt out, and the streets belong to the dead.
outbreak.sandbox.title: Sandbox settings
outbreak.sandbox.intro: Change any rule and the preset becomes Custom.
outbreak.sandbox.bbox: Arnis bounding box (min lat, min lng, max lat, max lng)
outbreak.sandbox.preset.survivor.desc: TWD heroics: fewer walkers, only bites infect, plenty to find, and you keep your survivor when you die.
outbreak.sandbox.preset.apocalypse.desc: Like Project Zomboid: slow but many, any scratch can kill you, one life.
outbreak.sandbox.preset.builder.desc: For building: hardly any walkers, no infection, loot everywhere.
outbreak.sandbox.preset.nightmare.desc: Sprinters, in big herds, and next to nothing to find. Good luck.
outbreak.character.title: Who were you?
outbreak.character.intro: Good traits cost points, bad ones give them back.
outbreak.character.in_memory: In memory of %s: %s days, %s walkers put down.
outbreak.character.name: Name
outbreak.sheet.title: Character
outbreak.sheet.nobody: You haven't made your survivor yet.
outbreak.profession.unemployed.desc: No job, no skills, nothing much on you. But plenty of points for traits.
outbreak.profession.nurse.desc: Worked nights at the UMCG. Knows how to dress a wound.
outbreak.profession.police_officer.desc: Fit and used to a fight. Starts with the baton.
outbreak.profession.carpenter.desc: Good with a hammer: barricades go up easier. Has tools, nails and planks.
outbreak.profession.mechanic.desc: Knows cars inside out: hotwiring, repairs. Has a wrench and a screwdriver.
outbreak.profession.student.desc: Learns fast and has a bicycle. What else does a Groninger need?
outbreak.profession.farmer.desc: From the flat land outside town. Strong, handy, has an axe and seeds.
outbreak.profession.firefighter.desc: Fit and strong, with a good axe.
Strong. Has a pickaxe and a crowbar.
outbreak.profession.chef.desc: Handy with a knife. Has food to share.
outbreak.profession.burglar.desc: Quiet on their feet; can hotwire a car with bare hands.
outbreak.trait.strong.desc: +4 kg carrying, and your hits shove walkers harder.
outbreak.trait.athletic.desc: A little faster, and tire much more slowly.
outbreak.trait.lucky.desc: Find more loot; a better chance to hotwire.
outbreak.trait.brave.desc: Panic builds up half as fast.
outbreak.trait.thick_skinned.desc: A quarter of walker hits don't break the skin.
outbreak.trait.light_footed.desc: Your footsteps carry much less far.
outbreak.trait.inconspicuous.desc: Walkers see you from a quarter less far.
outbreak.trait.organized.desc: A worn bag carries its contents 15% lighter.
outbreak.trait.weak.desc: -4 kg carrying, and your hits barely shove.
outbreak.trait.out_of_shape.desc: A little slower, and tire much faster.
outbreak.trait.unlucky.desc: Find less loot; a worse chance to hotwire.
outbreak.trait.thin_skinned.desc: A quarter of walker hits go deeper than they would.
outbreak.trait.clumsy.desc: Your footsteps carry half again as far.
outbreak.trait.conspicuous.desc: Walkers see you from further away.
outbreak.trait.prone_to_illness.desc: Wounds and bandages get infected twice as easily.
outbreak.trait.short_sighted.desc: Lost your glasses: everything far away is a blur.
outbreak.trait.burglar.desc: Hotwires cars with bare hands, and more often.
outbreak.ignition.insert: Right-click: put the key in and turn it
outbreak.ignition.no_key: No key (hotwire it with a screwdriver)
outbreak.timeline.power_out: Somewhere in the city a transformer bangs, and the lights die. The power is out.
outbreak.tap.dry: The tap coughs, spits, and runs dry.
outbreak.pump.no_power: The pump's display is dark. No power.
outbreak.pump.how: %s L left in this pump. Hold a jerrycan, or park next to it.
outbreak.pump.filled_can: Filled the jerrycan: %s L (%s L left in the pump)
outbreak.pump.filled_tank: Filled the tank: %s L (%s L left in the pump)
outbreak.radio.flat: The batteries are flat, and you have no new ones.
outbreak.radio.died: The radio fades out. Flat batteries.
outbreak.alert.title: NL-Alert
outbreak.alert.0: Groningen: serious incident in and around the UMCG. Stay indoors. Close windows and doors. Do not go to the hospital. More information: RTV Noord.
outbreak.alert.1: Groningen and surroundings: people are attacking others in the street. Do not open your door to strangers. Keep away from anyone who is ill or has been bitten.
outbreak.alert.2: Province of Groningen: the army has closed the A7, the A28 and the ring road. Do not try to leave the city. Wait for instructions.
outbreak.alert.3: Groningen: evacuation centre at the Euroborg, open today until 20:00. Bring ID, medicine and one bag. Go on foot.
outbreak.alert.4: Groningen: the Euroborg evacuation centre is CLOSED. Do not go there. Stay where you are.
outbreak.radio.0: This is RTV Noord. There are reports of violence near the UMCG and on the Grote Markt. The police ask everyone to stay indoors. We will keep broadcasting.
outbreak.radio.1: RTV Noord, emergency broadcast. People who are bitten fall ill within hours, and then... they become dangerous. Lock them out. Do not try to help them. Aim for the head.
outbreak.radio.2: Emergency broadcast. Evacuation at the Euroborg today, until eight tonight. Army escorts leave the Hoofdstation every hour. Do not take your car: the roads are blocked.
outbreak.radio.3: ...the Euroborg is overrun. I repeat, the Euroborg is overrun. Stay away from crowds. Noise draws them. Do not... [static]
outbreak.radio.4: This is a recorded message from the Veiligheidsregio Groningen. Stay indoors. Ration your water. Boil water from the canals before you drink it. Help is on its way.
outbreak.radio.5: [The emergency tone. Then the recorded message again, slower, as if the tape is stretching.] ...help is on its way...
outbreak.guts.applied: You smear the guts all over yourself. You smell like one of them now. Walk, don't run.
outbreak.guts.washed: The water washes the guts off. They can smell you again.
outbreak.guts.ran: Running, you shake it off. They can smell you again.
outbreak.guts.attacked: The others turn. They know what you are.
outbreak.guts.worn_off: The guts have dried and flaked off. They can smell you again.
